deployments_detail.use: Content recommendation algorithm on TF1+ streaming platform
Automatic thumbnail identification on TF1+ streaming platform
Enriched campaign reports generation via Autopilot Agentic
TF1 Pub partnership with Aive using generative AI to automate creation of ad variations from source video
Data collaboration and audience targeting via Graph:ID
Content recommendation algorithm on the TF1+ streaming platform, developed in-house by TF1's AI and data-science team to personalize content surfacing for viewers.
Automatic thumbnail identification on the TF1+ streaming platform: AI selects representative preview images/thumbnails for content automatically.

Multimodal AI video indexing, automatic tagging and content summarization of TF1's video library using Moments Lab's MXT models, to make archives searchable and speed content discovery. [Moments Lab (MXT)]

Top Chrono: AI-generated on-demand sports match summaries (viewer chooses 5, 10 or 15-minute cuts) using AI highlight/key-moment identification. Launched for Rugby World Cup 2023 and extended to further sports events on TF1+.
Generative AI embedded in TF1 Info's editorial CMS to assist journalists with technical article-qualification tasks: automatic tagging, geolocation, and SEO optimization of written news content.

Centralized data and AI platform on Snowflake replacing fragmented team-by-team tools, giving TF1 a 360-degree view of user behavior across 26 million logged-in profiles to power personalization and audience analytics. [Snowflake]
Internal secure ChatGPT-style generative-AI assistant for TF1 employees, deployed with data-security controls so that no data is shared with the underlying model provider.

AI-augmented software development: TF1 engineering teams use AI coding copilots (GitHub Copilot and Claude Code) to boost developer productivity, per TF1 Group's own developer job postings which require advanced use of these tools. [GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude (Claude Code)]

Autopilot Agentic: conversational AI agent for TF1 Pub that generates advertising-campaign reports and audience recommendations, cutting report creation from ~4 days to under 5 minutes. Built on Snowflake Intelligence with consultancy Artefact, leveraging TF1's proprietary Graph:ID customer-data system. [Snowflake (Snowflake Intelligence / Cortex), Artefact]
deployments_detail.value: report creation reduced from 4 days to under 5 minutes

deployments_detail.use: TF1 Pub partnership with Aive to automate advertising-spot post-production: a creative AI copilot generates all optimized variations/declinations of a video ad from a single original spot for digital and CTV. [Aive]

TF1 AdManager self-serve ad platform for SMEs: generative-AI creative tool automatically produces a video ad spot in seconds from an advertiser's website URL (no prompt needed), plus AI campaign simulation, enabling TV/streaming campaigns from EUR 1,000.
deployments_detail.value: campaign entry ticket EUR 1,000; ad spot generated in seconds
